about: Model -> Loom card for 1bit serve's GPU route (docs/loom-route.md). A .gguf served on the GPU (--device auto or hrx) whose entry matches runs on loom-serve (AMD's Loom programs on the HRX runtime); every other model runs on the llama.cpp fork's llama-server as before. An entry is added only after the model passed the Loom-vs-fallback gate (interleaved A/B speed and accuracy on strixhalo, docs/loom-route.md "Gate"), with the gate's result linked in `gate`. Empty until a model passes.

routes.why: The card's own Strix Halo quick start, measured as shipped against our fallback on the same file: 2.132x prefill / 1.86x decode, greedy agreement 5/5 = 100 %, fallback bit-identical and Loom text-stable across repeats. Held back from merge-ready until Loom through 1bit serve stops returning an empty stream (the loom-proxy arm: pieces=0, cl-1077 on engine#3254/#3255) and that arm is measured on this row.
routes.measured: unsloth Qwen3.8-27B UD-Q4_K_XL (2a5f3565), strixhalo, 2026-11-21/22, 4 rounds with round 1 discarded, 8000-char prompts, 256-token greedy decodes: fallback (recipe qwen35-mtp-max-3 applied) 295.4 prefill / 15.4 decode (code/prose/short 15.4/13.9/17.7); loom-shipped 629.1 / 28.7 (28.7/25.1/30.9) = 2.132x prefill, 1.86x decode. engine#3158#issuecomment-7070923290
